info.name: SANA API
info.description:
SANA turns an idea into a structured, visual project for Technology, Business, Education and Creativity, with an AI assistant (n8n).

**How to run:** import this file, then click **Run collection** (Collection Runner). Run the folders in order: each folder creates what it needs, saves IDs into collection variables, and deletes its project at the end.

**Login:** HTTP Basic. A fresh test account is registered automatically on every run (`{{email}}` / `{{password}}`), plus a second account for the security checks.

**Variables:** `baseUrl` is the live server. IDs (`projectId`, `outputId`, …) and `graphRevision` are filled in by the test scripts.

**AI requests** need the n8n workflows to be active; the "Wait for …" requests poll every 3 seconds until n8n has answered.

All other requests log in with HTTP Basic as `{{email}}` / `{{password}}`.

**Public.** A second account, used later to prove users cannot reach each other's projects.
Negative test: a wrong password is rejected with a JSON 401 (no browser login popup). Runs before the first login, because after a login the session cookie would authenticate the request.

item.name: 3. AI assistant
item.description:
AI requests are asynchronous: the backend stores the request, sends it to n8n and answers **202**; n8n calls back later.
The "Wait for …" requests repeat themselves every 3 seconds until the request has finished (requires the Collection Runner).
Needs the n8n workflows to be active.
